name: nudge-me
description: Nudges in Claude Code: take a break, go to bed, and any reminder you set with /nudge or by asking Claude.

sit_minutes.title: Break nudge after (minutes)
sit_minutes.description: Unbroken time at the keyboard before the status line and agent launches nudge a break. The status line gets louder at twice this.

away_minutes.title: A break is (minutes)
away_minutes.description: Time with no keyboard or mouse input that counts as a break.

bedtime_nudge.title: Bedtime nudge
bedtime_nudge.description: Show a wrap-up nudge in the status line between bedtime and wake-up.

bedtime_hour.title: Bedtime (hour, 0-23)
bedtime_hour.description: Local hour the bedtime nudge starts.

wake_hour.title: Wake-up (hour, 0-23)
wake_hour.description: Local hour the bedtime nudge ends.
